verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's own docs confirm it ships automations and event-triggered flows. A community user describes a 'Haven't seen you in a while' winback email as simple to set up. However, nothing in the pack documents multi-step sequences, conditional branches, time delays, or exit rules, so the story's depth is unproven. Missing for 10: documented branching/conditional splits, delay/wait steps, exit/filter rules, explicit welcome-series and onboarding templates, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can build multi-step lifecycle automations — welcome series, onboarding, winback — with branches, delays, and exit rules

citations.quote: use the drag-and-drop email/SMS editors and build automations, segmentation and reports
Merchants can set up flows based on Klaviyo events to send out branded notifications
